`taps.wav` is a synthetic mono PCM16 fixture at 24 kHz. It contains 15
inharmonic, decaying taps at 220 ms intervals, in three increasing dynamic
groups of five takes. The first attack is at 100 ms. Small seeded background
noise checks the onset threshold.

SHA-256: `2e05dd4b28e1a8c4674e502590483466918068779d047775b6c9708c1598b0d8`.

The repository's MIT license covers this synthetic fixture. Generated user
packs carry the separate `user recording` provenance label.
